signal: Qualia partnered with Google to bring agentic AI to title and escrow and added Axos Bank to its Bank Partner Network.

email.body1:
Timothy, saw Qualia partnered with Google on agentic AI for title and escrow and just added Axos to the Bank Partner Network.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns buying signals into booked meetings with zero rep time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Qualia off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Timothy, quick follow-up for Qualia.

Most RevOps teams have the signals but lose days getting them researched, written, and routed to a rep, so the in-market window closes first. The measurable lift comes from collapsing that latency, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I would make. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Timothy, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, live in four weeks with every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Qualia's reply rate likely compares to peer real-estate-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Timothy, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If turning signals into meetings faster isn't a RevOps priority right now, no problem at all. A big AI partnership makes for a full roadmap, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a pipeline gap analysis scoped to Qualia's motion? I will tailor it to your team either way.
